# Saga Forge

> Declarative, annotation-driven saga orchestration for Java 21 and Spring Boot 4.1. A saga is a plain `@Saga` class whose `@SagaStep` methods react to `@DomainEvent`s and dispatch `@Command`s through a `CommandGateway` to `@CommandHandler`s on aggregates or services; the runtime correlates events by an association property, runs steps in a saga-scoped unit of work in the application's Postgres transaction, retries transient failures, and compensates committed steps. Published on Maven Central as `io.github.gkosharovdev:saga-forge-*:0.1.0` (Apache-2.0).

Key rules: steps return `void` and send commands through `CommandGateway` (never return them); handlers and aggregates record events with `DomainEvents.record(...)`; application code publishes with Saga Forge's `EventPublisher`, never Spring's `ApplicationEventPublisher`; exactly one `@SagaId String` field; at most one `SagaContext` and one `CommandGateway` field; `SagaContext` values are JSON scalars (store `BigDecimal` as a String); handlers calling outside systems take a `CommandId` and pass `commandId.value()` as the idempotency key. The model is validated at startup and every error is listed at once.

## Guide

- [Guide index](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/README.md): what each page covers, vocabulary
- [Getting started](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/getting-started.md): Maven/Gradle coordinates, schema setup, the canonical saga
- [Model reference](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/model-reference.md): every annotation, where it goes, companions, attributes and defaults
- [Validation rules](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/validation-rules.md): exact startup error texts mapped to their fix
- [Recipes](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/recipes.md): multi-aggregate unit of work, compensation, retry and idempotency, outbox commands, modular monolith
- [Testing](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/testing.md): `SagaFixture` given/when/then tests
- [Operations](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/operations.md): properties, Actuator, OpenTelemetry, schema upgrades
- [Limitations](https://github.com/gkosharovdev/saga-forge/blob/master/docs/guide/limitations.md): what to design around in 0.1.0
